objective: Install and validate a persistent local IA Business queue worker without modifying gameplay or main.
requirements: Verify exact repository and clean git state before acting.
Never modify, checkout, merge, commit to, or push main.
Implement the worker as a small auditable script under ia-business/worker/ and keep runtime state outside gameplay files.

The worker must fetch origin/ia-business-sync, discover ready tasks, reject tasks requiring human approval, reject nonzero cost, acquire an exclusive lock, execute only allowlisted low-risk task kinds, write structured results, and push only to ia-business-sync.
Do not create a general arbitrary remote shell. TASK payloads must not contain free-form shell commands for automatic execution.

Install a Windows per-user startup/scheduled trigger only if it can be done without administrator privileges, without payment, and reversibly. Prefer an event/short idle-efficient mechanism; if Windows forces polling, use a conservative interval and document it.
Do not store secrets or credentials in the repository.
Run a self-test proving the worker can see TASK-0002, that main remains unchanged, and that no gameplay file changed.

After successful installation, mark TASK-0002 completed via ia-business/results/TASK-0002.json and report the exact trigger installed, its status, worker PID/process state if applicable, tests run, and rollback/uninstall command.
If any unexpected permission, credential, administrator, security, or destructive prompt is required, stop and report blocked instead of bypassing it.
success_criteria: Persistent/restartable local trigger installed and enabled
